title: Link
description: Somewhere to go, offered as a button: where it leads (`href`), what it is called (`label`), an icon before the words. A file to fetch is a link too, told so (`download`: true, or the name the file is saved under).

label.description: What is pressed, as it is read.

icon.description: An icon name before the words (`ph:bold/download`).

download.description: A file to fetch rather than a page to open: true, or the name it is saved under.
